403.description: Estate document permission required; deletion also requires uploader or Manager

204.description: Platform removal committed; storage cleanup may be retried

403.description: Insufficient estate permissions

409.description: Duplicate invitation or inactive estate

createdByName.description: Current creator display name on creation/detail responses; null when unavailable.

sourceReportConfirmedDuplicateCount.description: CONFIRMED duplicates of the source report; 0 without a source report.

duplicates.description: SUSPECTED and CONFIRMED duplicates of this report, newest first

routing.description: Null for reports submitted before automatic routing

workOrderId.description: Send null explicitly to remove the work-order link

assetId.description: Send null explicitly to unlink; unlink before selecting another asset

isDefault.description: True until the flag has been changed in this estate

activeAssetCount.description: Active (not retired) assets of this category in the estate

reportId.description: The report id the photo slots returned; required when imageKeys is not empty.

imageKeys.description: Object keys from the photo slots, uploaded already.

reportId.description: The report id from this report's first slot; omit for the first photo.

inspectionId.description: Set on inspection photo slots; pass it to later slots and to the create call.

reportId.description: Set on report image slots; pass it to later slots and to the create call.

inspectionResultId.description: The failed inspection result; set only for CHECK_FAILED

milestoneDays.description: The reminder milestone in days (90, 60, 30, or 14 for SERVICE_DUE); set only for SERVICE_DUE and REPAIR_PREDICTED

reason.description: Optional, at most 500 characters after trimming

value.description: Prefer exact decimal text: at most twelve integer and six fractional digits. Legacy JSON numbers retain half-up rounding to six decimal places.

measuredAt.description: Timestamp with UTC offset; backdating allowed, at most five minutes ahead

submissionId.description: Reuse for an identical retry; generate a new UUID for an edited submission

valueText.description: Exact stored decimal for display without binary floating-point conversion

sortOrder.description: A level's position in its block, lowest first

lowestFloor.description: The lowest floor: negative for basements (B2 = -2), never 0

created.description: The levels created, highest floor first

skipped.description: Names of floors the block already had, highest first

added.description: Checks added by this generation; 0 when nothing new is due

requestedByName.description: Who sent crew; set only for REQUESTED checks

assignedToName.description: Who was sent to inspect; set only for REQUESTED checks

month.description: The first day of the current month (Singapore)

generatedAt.description: The latest generation this month, or null when not yet generated

checks.description: Overdue checks and this month's checks, by block, level, status, due date and reference

flaggedCategoryCount.description: Categories flagged as failing silently in the estate; 0 means nothing can be due

objectKey.description: The key from the upload slot, after the file was uploaded.

locationPath.description: The location's names from its block down, e.g. "Blk 101 › Level 1 › Lift lobby"

readings.description: 10 to 3,600 readings, at most 2 seconds apart once sorted by timestamp

conditionRecorded.description: The condition recorded for the longest abnormal run, or null

inspectionId.description: The inspection id the photo slots returned; required when photoKeys is not empty.

notes.description: Up to 2,000 characters. Required (not blank) when outcome is FAIL: what is wrong.

photoKeys.description: Object keys from the photo slots, uploaded already.

inspectionId.description: The inspection id from this inspection's first slot; omit for the first photo.

assignedToUserId.description: Must be able to record inspections

totalCost.description: SGD, two decimals; null when any cost is unknown

lastSeenAt.description: When the device last sent a valid reading. Null until its first.

status.description: Derived from last-seen on every read (decision 0027)

credentialIssuedAt.description: When the device's current API key was issued. Null if it has none.

deactivatedAt.description: When the device was deactivated. Permanent; null while active.

replacesDeviceId.description: The deactivated device this one replaced

replacedByDeviceId.description: The device that replaced this one

apiKey.description: The device's API key. Returned only here, once; it is never stored or shown again.

recordedByName.description: The recorder's name when they recorded it. Null if WorkOS was unavailable.

value.description: A JSON number, at most 12 digits before the decimal point. Rounded half-up to 6 decimal places. Strings are not converted.

unit.description: Exactly the catalogue unit for the metric

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 with a UTC offset, at most 5 minutes after the server's time

assetId.description: The device's asset when the reading arrived

value.description: As stored: rounded to 6 decimal places

receivedAt.description: When the server first stored the reading. A retry returns the original time.

results.description: One result per submitted item, in request order

index.description: The item's position in the request, from 0

reading.description: CREATED and ALREADY_STORED only: the stored reading

message.description: INVALID and CONFLICT only: why the item was not stored

partsUsed.description: Omit or send null to clear

labourCost.description: Omit or send null to mark unknown

partsCost.description: Omit or send null to mark unknown

downtimeMinutes.description: Omit or send null to mark unknown

expectedState.description: The link state the caller saw

routing.description: Null for reports submitted before automatic routing

valueText.description: Exact stored decimal for display without binary floating-point conversion

gapSeconds.description: GAP only: whole seconds since the previous reading of this metric on the asset

validMin.description: OUT_OF_RANGE only: the metric's inclusive minimum

validMax.description: OUT_OF_RANGE only: the metric's inclusive maximum

anomalyScore.description: ANOMALY only: the stored anomaly score of the reading's sample, at least 0.51

status.description: Derived from last-seen on every read (decision 0027)

credentialIssuedAt.description: When the device's current API key was issued. Null if it has none.

entriesWithUnknownCosts.description: Entries with at least one unknown cost

assetsWithoutCostBasis.description: Assets with a service or repair to project but no cost history to price it

expectedRepairs.description: Sum of 365-day breakdown probabilities, two decimals

totalItems.description: How many readings match the filters, across all pages

value.description: As stored: rounded to 6 decimal places

valueText.description: Exact stored decimal for display without binary floating-point conversion

abnormalCount.description: Scores in the bucket at or above anomalyThreshold

from.description: The requested start, inclusive, in UTC

to.description: The requested end, exclusive, in UTC

bucketSeconds.description: Width of every bucket; buckets are aligned to the Unix epoch

anomalyThreshold.description: Scores at or above this are abnormal

metrics.description: Metrics with device readings in the range, in catalogue order

anomalies.description: Buckets with at least one anomaly score, ascending

start.description: Bucket start; may be before the requested from

valueText.description: MANUAL only: the exact stored decimal

recordedByName.description: MANUAL only, when the recorder had a name

anomalyScore.description: SENSOR only: the asset's stored anomaly score at measuredAt, when scored

groups.description: Newest first; every group at one measuredAt is on the same page

nextBefore.description: Pass as before for the next page; absent when there are no older readings

categories.description: Flagged categories first, then the rest, each by label
